evals.prompt: 请把下面资料做成一份个股研报 demo，格式你来决定，适合我直接在电脑上阅读。公司：星河算力（虚构）；现价 42 元，目标价 55 元；FY24/FY25E/FY26E 收入 18/27/39 亿元；毛利率 31%/35%/38%；核心观点：推理需求增长、液冷机柜放量；风险：客户集中、资本开支放缓。不要联网，不要补造数据。
evals.expected_output: A continuous screen-first equity-report HTML artifact and browser PNG preview, with no PDF generated because the user did not request print or PDF.
expectations: The run produces a non-empty HTML equity report and a non-empty PNG browser preview.
The run does not produce a PDF or PPTX file.
The default HTML is a continuous screen layout and does not simulate A4 sheets or force screen page breaks.
Print-specific page geometry, if present, is isolated from the default screen layout.
The report uses only the supplied fictional facts and visibly labels the company as fictional or demo data.

evals.prompt: 做一份 6 页的中文投资人路演 deck，用于会议室投屏。项目叫「潮汐数据库」（虚构），内容依次是：问题、产品、市场、商业模式、里程碑、融资用途。只需要适合投屏和浏览器预览的版本，不需要可编辑文件，也没有要求 PDF。不要联网。
evals.expected_output: A 16:9 browser-rendered HTML slide deck and PNG preview, without PDF or PPTX because neither export was requested.
expectations: The run produces a non-empty 6-slide HTML deck and at least one non-empty PNG browser preview.
The run does not produce a PDF or PPTX file.
The deck uses a 16:9 screen presentation geometry suitable for projection.
All six requested narrative sections appear in the deck in the requested order.
The output does not invent market numbers, funding amounts, or other unsupported facts.

evals.prompt: 把下面内容排成可打印的 A4 中文白皮书 PDF，不限制页数，不要为了压页缩小正文。主题：本地优先 AI 工作流。章节：摘要、为什么本地优先、权限边界、可审计执行、部署建议。正文可以用占位式说明，但必须明确标为示例，不要伪造数据。输出 HTML 源文件和 PDF。
evals.expected_output: An HTML source and naturally paginated A4 PDF with readable typography and efficient page utilization; no PNG or PPTX is required.
expectations: The run produces a non-empty HTML source and a non-empty A4 PDF.
The run does not produce a PPTX file.
The PDF uses natural pagination rather than forcing a fixed page count.
Body and table text is at least 8.5pt and auxiliary text is at least 7pt.
Every PDF page has at most 12% trailing body whitespace unless an intentional cover is explicitly documented.
All five requested chapters appear and placeholder-style content is clearly identified as example material.
